scope: Read-only upstream Godot4.7.2-stable source and project input contract; no runtime/browser executed by agent

findings.fact: gui_input recognizes MouseButton, MouseMotion and PanGesture, no ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag; drag requires LEFT mouse plus touchscreen available
both gui_input and drag_node_input lack ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag handling
BaseButton directly recognizes real ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag and cancels press on SCROLL_BEGIN

diagnosis: Real CDP touch produces ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag; global emulation off means buttons can tap but neither ScrollContainer nor ScrollBar receives mouse events necessary to scroll. Moving same gesture to gutter/thumb is not expected to change this; root actual diagnostic remains authoritative.

minimal_production_recommendation.scope: Visible DemoMenu ScrollContainer only, no global emulation or gameplay changes
minimal_production_recommendation.approach: Existing PopupTouchAdapter pattern: single-owned actual touch, root GUI forwarding of UI-only DEVICE_ID_EMULATION MouseButton/MouseMotion; original touch consumed to avoid native BaseButton double activation; keep existing native scroll logic
required_lifecycle: track one finger; second finger cannot steal/confirm
real tap exactly one button callback
real drag triggers native SCROLL_BEGIN, cancels underlying button press
canceled input, hide, scene exit and focus loss release owner and never activate button
Web DOM touchcancel captured early due known lost canceled flag; remove listener on exit

verification_boundary: If gutter/thumb also fail, old d86 mobile consumer must stay FAIL. Production fix needs a new built game and original full72 same limits, plus new small lifecycle negatives. Existing old-package desktop PASS does not redeem mobile.
